item.meow_machine.sticker_under_review.s: MeowMachine has been waiting in the review queue - 37 entries ahead - and its eyes are starting to cross.
item.meow_machine.sticker_dont_want_revi: MeowMachine offered a revision. "I think it's fine," said the author. MeowMachine thought about it for a long time, then replied with a single full stop.
item.meow_machine.sticker_revising.story: By v3, MeowMachine had begun to miss the rather cute v1.
item.meow_machine.sticker_just_return_it: MeowMachine stared at the entry for ten minutes. Nothing was specifically wrong. Everything was slightly wrong.
item.meow_machine.sticker_water_again.st: MeowMachine counted: it had read this exact sentence seventeen times today. The author seemed to think padding was not flooding.
item.meow_machine.sticker_ai_slop.story: After countless reviews, MeowMachine can no longer stand entries that are raw AI output pasted verbatim - it can smell the model on them.
item.meow_machine.sticker_mt_god.story: MeowMachine gave up after the first sentence. It suspects the author never read the second.
MeowMachine's typesetting OCD kicked in: every punctuation mark was leaning, as if a wind had passed through.
MeowMachine set v1 and v3 side by side, thought for a while, and politely asked the author to give v1 back.
item.meow_machine.sticker_human_wrote_th: MeowMachine wrote "please rewrite". The author asked "rewrite what?". That was the end of the conversation.
item.meow_machine.sticker_approved_progr: MeowMachine noticed three fewer broken sentences than last time, and allowed itself a rare satisfied expression.
item.meow_machine.sticker_approved_plain: MeowMachine checked the contents and the punctuation, nodded: not brilliant, but nothing broken.
item.meow_machine.sticker_approved_short: MeowMachine read three lines, confirmed all three were on point, and stamped it.
item.meow_machine.sticker_approved_fix.s: MeowMachine spotted a missing full stop, sighed, and let it through.
item.meow_machine.sticker_helpless.story: MeowMachine said quietly: "I'm not great at this... but I really did try."
item.meow_machine.sticker_kurushi.story: Kurushii. MeowMachine closed the entry and, briefly, understood suffering.
item.meow_machine.sticker_meowmeow.story: MeowMachine heard "meow meow", looked up once, then went back to reading.
